researchResults.title: Skild AI unveils S1 flagship robot foundation model
researchResults.description:
Skild AI says its S1 robot foundation model enables robots to learn new tasks just by seeing a video of it being performed.

The post Skild AI unveils S1 flagship robot foundation model appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: How better grippers can unlock physical AI
researchResults.description:
Physical AI depends on smarter grippers to give robots the dexterity, sensing and adaptability needed to handle real-world tasks.

The post How better grippers can unlock physical AI appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Reframe Systems raises $40M to scale its robotic microfactories for home building
researchResults.description:
Reframe Systems aims to build a network of automated microfactories near communities where homes are needed.

The post Reframe Systems raises $40M to scale its robotic microfactories for home building appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: The edge AI wall: Why embodied AI requires new mathematics
researchResults.description:
Computational overload is not a bug of a specific planner, but an edge AI wall limiting physical and embodied AI.

The post The edge AI wall: Why embodied AI requires new mathematics appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Early bird pricing for RoboBusiness 2026 ends August 31
researchResults.description:
Early bird pricing for RoboBusiness 2026, which saves attendees $200 on full conference passes, will end Aug. 31.

The post Early bird pricing for RoboBusiness 2026 ends August 31 appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
researchResults.description: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.

researchResults.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
researchResults.description: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

researchResults.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
researchResults.description: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

researchResults.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
researchResults.description: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

researchResults.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
researchResults.description: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.
